title: Choose the Workout composition
question: All three keep Trophē’s Personal Best identity. Choose the structure that should organize the complete Workout experience.

options.label: Coach’s Session Board
options.thesis: Today’s exact session leads, with moving exercise previews and progress evidence arranged around one Review plan action.
options.viewport: A compact readiness rail sits above one large coach-approved session card; the exercise filmstrip and Review plan action are visible without scrolling.
options.risk: The daily session can dominate discovery unless Explore and My plans remain clearly reachable.

options.label: Training Journey Lanes
options.thesis: Assigned, recommended, and saved plans become three unmistakable lanes, each previewable before it can become a live workout.
options.viewport: A small Today strip anchors the top while a horizontal journey card shows duration, equipment, muscle focus, coach status, and Preview plan.
options.risk: The library can feel heavier for a client who only wants to log one quick session.

options.label: Interactive Muscle Atlas
options.thesis: A truthful front/back muscle map is the main navigator; selecting an area reveals exact exercises and builds a visible plan tray.
options.viewport: A centered front/back anatomical figure shares the first screen with body-area filters, today’s target, and a compact Review plan tray.
options.risk: Anatomy-first navigation needs an equally fast search path for users who already know the exercise name.
